overview: Deliver the Initial Pitch using the 5 Non‑Negotiables. Set the tone, build credibility, and secure the inspection.
learningObjectives: Use professional body language, tone, and posture

sections.title: 5 Non‑Negotiables
sections.content: 1) Who you are 2) Who we are (Roof‑ER) 3) Make it relatable 4) What you’re there to do (inspection) 5) Go for the close.

data.scenario: Introduce yourself and ask for the inspection.

quiz.question: The 5 Non‑Negotiables are…
options: Who you are, who we are, make it relatable, what you’re there to do, go for the close
quiz.correctAnswer: Who you are, who we are, make it relatable, what you’re there to do, go for the close
